questions.q: Arcades shall be cantilevered from the building line over the sidewalk and the horizontal clearance between the curb line and the outermost face of any part of the arcade shall not be less than:
questions.n: This is the minimum mandated horizontal clearance to prevent vehicular impact while allowing for arcade cantilevers.

questions.q: Printing plants shall be classified under what type of occupancy (sec 701)?
questions.n: Under Section 701, printing plants fall under Group E (Business and Mercantile).

questions.q: Power plants shall be classified under what type of occupancy (sec 701)?
questions.n: Power plants are classified under Group I (Industrial) occupancies.

questions.q: Convents shall be classified under what type of occupancy (sec 701)?
questions.n: Convents are classified as residential-style occupancies under Group B.

questions.q: Repair garages shall be classified under what type of occupancy (sec 701-Group G-div 4)?
questions.n: Repair garages are classified under Group G (Storage and Hazardous) due to flammable materials.

questions.q: Reformatories shall be classified under what type of occupancy?
questions.n: Reformatories are facilities where occupants are restrained or under care, placing them in Group D.

questions.q: Gasoline stations are under what classification of occupancy?
questions.n: Gas stations are grouped under Business and Mercantile for zoning and occupancy purposes.

questions.q: Office Buildings are under what classification of occupancy?
questions.n: Office buildings are the standard example of Group E occupancies.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does Mental Hospitals fall?
questions.n: Hospitals of all types are categorized as Institutional (Group D).

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does Monasteries fall?
questions.n: Like convents, monasteries are classified under Group B residential occupancies.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does Aircraft Hangars fall?
questions.n: Aircraft hangars are classified under Group E, specifically for business/service uses.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does Cold Storage and Creameries fall?
questions.n: Food processing plants like creameries are classified as Group I.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does Private Garage fall?
questions.n: Private garages are classified as Group J (Accessory) structures.

questions.q: Minimum loading slot requirement for Hospitals and hotels (table VII.4):
questions.n: Table VII.4 requires at least one loading slot for these large service buildings.

questions.q: Parking requirement for amusement centers (table VII.4):
questions.n: Amusement centers require one slot for every 50 sqm of area.

questions.q: Parking requirement for Public Markets (table VII.4):
o: 1:150 sqm of floor area for customer
questions.n: The code mandates one slot per 150 sqm of floor area for customers in public markets.

questions.q: Parking requirement for neighborhood shopping centers (table VII.4):
questions.n: Neighborhood shopping centers are regulated at 1 slot per 100 sqm.

questions.q: Parking requirement for multi-family living units of more than 100 sqm of living unit area (table VII.4):
questions.n: Units over 100 sqm are expected to have at least one dedicated parking slot.

questions.q: Parking requirement for multi-family living units of up to 50 sqm of living unit area (table VII.4):
questions.n: For units up to 50 sqm, the code requires 1 slot for every 8 units.

questions.q: Maximum projection of a balcony over a street of over 3 meters but not more than 6 mts (table X.I):
questions.n: On narrow streets (3-6m), the balcony cannot project more than 0.60m.

questions.q: Maximum projection of a balcony over a street of 10 mts to less than 11 mts in width (table X.I):
questions.n: For streets 10-11 meters wide, a projection of 1.00 meter is permitted.

questions.q: Maximum height of 1st floor for a 2-story wood structure with a height of 7 mts (table VII.5):
questions.n: The code allows a maximum first floor height of 4.50m for this specific wood structure.

questions.q: Maximum spacing of posts for 2-storey wooden structure with a height of 8 mts (table VII.5):
questions.n: For an 8-meter high wooden structure, posts can be spaced up to 4.50m apart.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does fences of over 1.80 mts in height fall (table VII.1)?
questions.n: Fences, regardless of height, are Group J Accessory structures.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does wood working establishments fall (table VII.1)?
questions.n: Due to fire risk, woodworking establishments are classified as Storage and Hazardous.

questions.q: Under what classification of occupancy does police and fire stations fall (table VII.1)?
questions.n: These are public service facilities classified under Institutional (Group D or E-2).

questions.q: Minimum number of exit for an Institutional type of structure (table XII.1):
questions.n: Institutional buildings require at least two separate ways out for safety.

questions.q: Minimum travel distance from exits to any point of the building without sprinkler system (sec 1207.2.d):
questions.n: In a building without a sprinkler system, the maximum travel distance to an exit is 45m.

questions.q: Minimum travel distance from exits to any point of the building with sprinkler system (sec 1207.2.d):
questions.n: A sprinkler system allows for an extended travel distance of 60 meters.

questions.q: A long interior passageway providing access to several rooms:
questions.n: A corridor is the official term for an interior passageway serving multiple rooms.

questions.q: A raised rim of concrete, stone or metal which forms the edge of street or sidewalk:
questions.n: The curb is the raised rim defining the edge of the street/sidewalk.

questions.q: The temperature at which a liquid is transformed or converted into vapor:
questions.n: The boiling point is the temperature where liquid phase changes to vapor.

questions.q: Minimum intensity of lights for exits (sec 1207.11):
questions.n: Exits must be illuminated at a minimum of 10.70 lux for safety.

questions.q: Minimum live load bearing capacity of a construction canopy:
questions.n: Protective canopies must support at least 600 kgs per square meter.

questions.q: Minimum lighting for canopies protecting the pedestrian during construction (sec 1106.4.f):
questions.n: The code requires 100-watt bulbs spaced every 6 meters under canopies.

questions.q: Minimum height of Construction fence (sec 1106.3):
questions.n: Construction fences must be at least 2.4 meters high to secure the site.

questions.q: Minimum height of protective railings for temporary walkways (sec 1106.3):
questions.n: Temporary walkway railings must be exactly 1.0 meter high for safety.

questions.q: Minimum thickness of wire-glass for bath tub (sec 1805.1):
questions.n: Wire-glass in bathtubs must be at least 5.6 mm thick.

questions.q: Minimum thickness of laminated glass for bath tub (sec 1805.1):
questions.n: Laminated glass must be at least 6.4 mm thick for use in bathtubs.

questions.q: Minimum thickness of tempered-glass for bath tub (sec 1805.1):
questions.n: Tempered glass is stronger and thus allowed at a minimum of 4.8 mm.

questions.q: When the distance bet. Inner edge of sidewalk to OFB is less than 1/2 of Building ht (sec 1106.3.a.b):
questions.n: Both a fence and a protective canopy are required in this proximity.

questions.q: When the distance bet. outer edge of sidewalk to OFB is less than 1/2 of Building ht (sec 1106.4.h):
questions.n: When reaching the outer edge, safety netting must be added to the fence and canopy.

questions.q: Amount fine for Grave Violation (sec 211.2.b):
questions.n: The maximum administrative fine for a Grave Violation is 10,000 php.

questions.q: Violation for non-posting of Occupancy and Building Permit:
questions.n: Failure to post permits is categorized as a light violation.

questions.q: Violation for use without appropriate Occupancy Permit (sec 212.2.):
questions.n: Occupying a building without a final permit is a 'Less Grave' violation.

questions.q: Demolition without permit:
questions.n: Demolishing a structure without authorization is a Grave Violation.

questions.q: Air supply per person per minute for auditoriums:
questions.n: The standard requirement is 0.30 cubic meters of air per person per minute.

questions.q: Minimum wind load capacity for roofs for vertical projection:
questions.n: Roofs must withstand a vertical wind load projection of 120 kgs/sqm.

questions.q: Minimum thickness of glass for jalousies:
questions.n: Standard jalousie glass blades must be at least 5.60 mm thick.

questions.q: Maximum length of glass for jalousies:
questions.n: Jalousie blades cannot exceed 1.20 meters in length for safety.
